title: 第7章 人各有志第8章 苍龙圆满登峰造极
content_zh:
清早，天刚蒙蒙亮。
冯越负手，慢条斯理地来到演武场内！
此刻天色尚早，早早有少年来此习武，一个个练得热火朝天。
但冯越盯着这些人的动作，心中却不由摇头。
‘邵卓，来帮内已经1个月了，却连苍龙劲都无法融会贯通，虽然勤勉，但难成大器！’
‘钟秉文，绿色词条，但根骨太差，一年内都无法入境！’
‘孙岱，天资尚可，可白色词条，潜力太低。’
……
现场的一个个帮众底细尽收入冯越眼底。
作为帮内新晋弟子的教头，他对这些年轻人都有所了解。
武道之路想要走的远，“悟性、毅力、词条、根骨、背景”五点缺一不可！
缺少任何一点，都有可能在这条路上走许多冤枉路。
而少了两点，前路渺茫！
至于缺了三点以上的，那更是想都不用想，除非你的长板真的突破天际。
在此刻冯越的判断中，现场的大部分人都是要被帮内淘汰，沦为底层混混的。
这也符合苍龙帮的利益。
武道第一境并无难点。
水磨工夫下，即使废物也能在两年内踏入淬体境，并于20年内达到淬体巅峰。
但不当家不知柴米贵！
钱要花在刀刃上。

武者不事生产脱产习武，消耗的资源堪称恐怖！
故而，这些签订了卖身契的帮众都是底层耗材！
无法在半年通过筛选，则被淘汰，一辈子供养那些天资上佳的武者吃穿用度。
苍龙帮核心帮众上百，平均每20个底层帮众就要供养一个武者。
而这些被供养的武者则坐镇旗下势力，维持秩序稳定，确保稳定产出各种资源，供修为达到后天的长老修行。
在这般层层盘剥下，苍龙帮内建立起一个金字塔结构。
作为金字塔顶端的，吃最大口的则是苍龙帮帮主。
只要帮主不倒，便是手下死绝，也可以重新拉起一个新的苍龙帮！
……
以仰视的姿态，冯越判断着演武场内帮众的进度。
恰在这时，一个清瘦身影步履稳健的迈步入场，吸引了冯越的目光。
‘是他……’
冯越注视着这个给他深刻印象的青年。
不仅仅是冯越，这两天下来，现场的许多人都注意到显眼包。
从入帮到现在，每天至少有7个时辰都泡在演武场内，一遍遍地演练《苍龙劲》！
如果只是努力还就罢了，演武场内并不缺这般认真之人。
但叶离的进步速度肉眼可见。
大家都是修行的同一套炼体功法，都是同一个师傅教的，练的怎么样一看就知道！
上午尚且生涩，到了晚上就已熟练。
第二天举手投足更是带着一股说不上来的韵味，有一股冯教头的风范，其对苍龙劲的精深程度已经超越了这里大部分人。

这下，所有人都知道，帮内来了个超天才。
只要叶离根骨过的去，成为核心弟子便是板上钉钉，前途无量！
便是冯越，也用欣赏的目光盯着这个帮内新来的年轻人。
content_en:
Early in the morning, it was just dawn.
Feng Yue put his hands behind his back and walked slowly to the martial arts arena!
It was still early in the day, and young people had come here early to practice martial arts, and all of them were practicing enthusiastically.
But Feng Yue stared at the movements of these people and couldn't help but shake his head.
‘Shao Zhuo, it’s been a month since I came to the gang, but I can’t even grasp the Canglong Jin. Although I work hard, I can’t achieve anything great! ’
‘Zhong Bingwen has a green entry, but his skills are too bad and he will not be able to enter the country within a year! ’
‘Sun Dai is quite talented, but with the white entry, his potential is too low. ’
…
The details of each and every gang member at the scene were revealed to Feng Yue.
As the instructor of the new disciples in the gang, he knows all about these young people.
If you want to go far on the road of martial arts, five points are indispensable: "comprehension, perseverance, vocabulary, foundation, and background"!
If any of them are missing, you may end up taking many wrong steps on this road.
But if two points are missing, the future will be bleak!
As for missing more than three points, you don’t even have to think about it, unless your longboard really breaks through the sky.
In Feng Yue's judgment at this moment, most of the people present were going to be eliminated from the gang and become low-level gangsters.
This is also in line with the interests of the Canglong Gang.
There is no difficulty in the first level of martial arts.
Under the water-milling technique, even waste can enter the body-tempering realm within two years, and reach the peak of body-tempering within 20 years.
But if you don’t become a householder, you don’t know that firewood and rice are expensive!
Money should be spent wisely.
The resources consumed by martial artists who do not work and practice martial arts are terrifying!
Therefore, these gangsters who have signed a contract of prostitution are all low-level consumables!
Those who fail to pass the screening within half a year will be eliminated and will have to feed and clothe those talented warriors for the rest of their lives.
The Canglong Gang has hundreds of core members, and on average every 20 bottom members support one warrior.
And these supported warriors sit in charge of their forces, maintain order and stability, and ensure the stable production of various resources for the cultivation of the elders who have reached the level of the day after tomorrow.
Under such layers of exploitation, a pyramid structure was established within the Canglong Gang.
As the top of the pyramid, the leader of the Canglong Gang has the biggest meal.
As long as the gang leader doesn't fall, even if his subordinates die, a new Canglong Gang can be started again!
…
Looking up, Feng Yue judged the progress of the gang members in the martial arts arena.
Just at this moment, a thin figure stepped onto the stage with steady steps, attracting Feng Yue's eyes.
'It's him...'
Feng Yue stared at this young man who impressed him deeply.
Not only Feng Yue, but also many people at the scene noticed the conspicuous bag in the past two days.
From joining the gang to now, I spend at least 7 hours every day in the martial arts arena, practicing "Cang Long Jin" over and over again!
If you just work hard and pay off, there is no shortage of such serious people in the martial arts arena.
But Ye Li's progress speed is visible to the naked eye.
Everyone practices the same set of physical exercises and is taught by the same master. You can tell just by looking at how you are doing!
It was still unfamiliar in the morning, but by the evening it was already proficient.
The next day, his movements had an indescribable charm, a demeanor like that of Coach Feng, whose proficiency in Canglong Jin had surpassed that of most people here.
Now, everyone knew that there was a super genius in the gang.
As long as Ye Ligen survives, becoming a core disciple is a sure thing and his future is boundless!
Even Feng Yue stared at this new young man in the gang with admiring eyes.
